name: SemiProbe
old_description: The SemiProbe Wafer Prober Platform is Easily Configurable to Adapt to Many Applications Over the Life of the Prober
about:
SemiProbe is headquartered in Winooski, Vermont. The company designs and manufactures wafer probing systems in the United States. No founding year or ownership details are publicly disclosed.

SemiProbe produces the Probe System for Life (PS4L) family of probing and inspection platforms, built on a patented adaptive architecture that makes components interchangeable, configurable, and field-upgradable. The product line includes complete manipulators, probe arms, probe tips, and automated probing systems for applications such as MEMS, high-frequency/microwave, high-power devices, optoelectronics, photonics, vacuum, double-sided, magnetic stimulation, and device characterization. All systems are designed and manufactured in the USA.

The company serves semiconductor manufacturers, research labs, and device characterization facilities working in MEMS, RF/microwave, power electronics, photonics, and advanced packaging. Customers use SemiProbe systems for wafer-level testing, high-frequency measurement, and automated production probing.

SemiProbe emphasizes modularity and long-term investment value: its PS4L architecture allows users to reconfigure or upgrade probers as test requirements change, avoiding full system replacement. The company states this approach maximizes prober investment value over the life of the equipment.
